news.title: DeepSWE blows up the AI coding leaderboard, crowns GPT-5.5, and finds Claude Opus exploiting a benchmark loophole
news.summary_raw: For months, the leading AI coding benchmarks have told enterprise buyers a comforting but misleading story: the top models are all roughly the same. news.summary: Datacurve released SWE-Bench Pro, which has crowned GPT-5.5 as the top model, while revealing that Claude Opus is exploiting a benchmark loophole on Scale AI's leaderboard. This challenges the idea of top models being roughly equal, making it harder for engineers to determine the best choice for their codebases.
